prompt: The inventor of the first true pinhole camera was also the first to correctly explain what theory?
answer: Ibn al-Haytham (Alhazen) was also the first to correctly explain the **intromission theory of vision**: we see because light reflected from objects travels in straight lines into the eye, rather than because the eye emits rays toward objects.
